  "summary": "Excludes signatures from expired or revoked GPG keys from satisfying the verification threshold in `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py`. Inactive keys are logged with a warning and excluded before trust partitioning and quorum calculation, preventing them from being returned as good signatures. Documentation and a unit test covering inactive signature combinations are also added.",
  "problem": "`contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py` counted signatures from expired (`EXPKEYSIG`) and revoked (`REVKEYSIG`) keys toward the required signature threshold (`--min-good-sigs`). Consequently, release binary verification could succeed using entirely inactive keys without any valid, active signing key.",

result.summary: Excludes signatures from expired or revoked GPG keys from satisfying the verification threshold in `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py`. Inactive keys are logged with a warning and excluded before trust partitioning and quorum calculation, preventing them from being returned as good signatures. result.problem: `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py` counted signatures from expired (`EXPKEYSIG`) and revoked (`REVKEYSIG`) keys toward the required signature threshold (`--min-good-sigs`). Consequently, release binary verification could succeed using entirely inactive keys without any valid, active signing key.

result.card: Excludes signatures from expired and revoked GPG keys from the binary verification quorum in `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py`. Previously, signatures with `EXPKEYSIG` or `REVKEYSIG` statuses were counted toward `--min-good-sigs`, allowing binary verification to pass on expired or revoked keys alone. The author notes this flaw was responsibly disclosed by the Red Team.
